comment: Declared before any Geant4 capture of this campaign exists (2026-11-21). The record carries this file's sha256.
tests: per case: two-sample chi2 of the transmitted primaries' energy loss, exit polar angle and lateral displacement, the reflected primaries' exit energy, the photon and delta energy spectra of the primary's direct children; two-sample z tests of the transmitted, reflected, stopped and annihilated fractions and of the photons and deltas per primary
pass: Bonferroni-corrected minimum p over every test of an arm >= 0.001

arms.null: Geant4 B vs Geant4 A (must pass: it measures the test's own false-failure rate)
arms.numpy: hepsimkernels.eslab (float64, msc on) vs Geant4 A+B
arms.device_float64: hepsimkernels.eslab_jax in float64 vs Geant4 A+B (counts and fractions only for secondaries)
arms.device_float32: hepsimkernels.eslab_jax in float32 vs Geant4 A+B

reported_without_pass_line.al_0p1_e-_95: Geant4 option 4 switches multiple-scattering models at 100 MeV; the mu2e-fastsim slab checks recorded a Geant4 95 vs 105 MeV difference on the same slab

amendments.after: the pilot (2 x 10k events per case), before the campaign
amendments.change: the stopped and annihilated fractions are compared as one absorbed fraction: Geant4 ends an in-flight annihilation with zero kinetic energy, so the recorder's end state cannot separate it from annihilation at rest (the pilot's labelling was wrong)

amendments.after: the pilot, before any campaign output exists; the reference configuration chosen by the user: FTFP_BERT_EMZ at option 4 defaults
amendments.change: the lateral displacement r of the cases above 100 MeV in which the primary crosses the slab in a single msc step is reported without a pass line: there Geant4 (WentzelVI) caps the displacement at the safety, which is about 0 on a boundary-limited step, so most exits sit at r = 0 exactly (pilot: 84 % in 1 mm Al, 98 % in 0.1 mm Al). Every other test keeps its line.
